description: Pipeline definition YAML schema, runner engine with parallel step execution, Convex storage, API endpoints, and dashboard view for CI/CD-style workflows. Migrated from Go to Bun + Convex stack.
deviation_notes: Original plan referenced Go code (internal/pipeline/, httptest, etc.) — all decommissioned. Rewrote plan for Bun + Convex stack: TypeScript types with Zod, Bun.spawn for execution, Convex mutations/queries for storage.
